committee: *Presentation of Certificate No. 406-38 (COR) - Senator Tina Rose Muña-Barnes
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting, Certificate No. 406-38 (COR) recognizing the graduating students of the Remetaw Community and congratulating them for successfully completing the 2025-2026 school year. Presentation will take place during the Remetaw Community of Guam Graduation Ceremony which begins at 10am on Saturday, June 27, 2026 at the Peleliu Abai in Lada, Dededo. Si Yu’os Ma’åse’! 6/24/26 3:13 p.m. (FN)
